record.issue_text: findMembers now mutates the model (sets members, user_count, offset, limit) rather than returning data, leaking paginated member-list view-state into the group domain model

adjudication.rationale: Verified: `Discourse.Group#findMembers` changed from returning an array of members (`then(function(result) { return result.map(...) })`) to mutating the group model via `self.setProperties({ user_count, limit, offset, members: ... })` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js). The model also gained pagination/view-state fields (`limit`, `offset`, `user_count`) at the top of the class. This does mix paginated member-list state into the group domain model, which is an architecture/scope concern, but the diff does not show a clear correctness break by itself.
